collections.name: Primitives
collections.description: Raw values with no meaning attached. The only layer allowed to contain literals. Created in Figma but hidden from the published library: a Figma alias needs its target to exist in the file, so the primitives must be there — designers just should not compose with them.

collections.name: Semantic
collections.description: The product vocabulary. The layer a client overrides to rebrand and the only one a designer composes with. Alias-only.

collections.name: Components
collections.description: Per-component geometry and type. Alias-only. Variant x colour matrices are deliberately absent — see tokens/component/button.json.
